Amnesia (Spells/rogue/amnesia.lua): 15 min on a normal mob, 5s on a boss (RTK's own isBoss branch -> durationMax). Wipes YOUR threat and blocks you as a target until it lapses or you hit the mob again. Needed a row because its spell_effects archetype had it extracted as Debuff/'slow', which is not what the script does. chance is the take-hold %: a miss just shakes off, no status/re-cast lock.

Confuse (Spells/mage/confuse.lua): a chance-based aggro RESET, NOT a debuff and NOT Amnesia's per-caster peel. Success wipes the mob's whole threat table and, if a creature stands on an adjacent tile, turns it on that creature (blind two side by side and spam Confuse -> they fight each other). No status, so it never says 'already cast'; a miss still spends mana. row.chance = take-hold %.
